event_name: Document 36 Date 02 November 2019 Time 13:29 2019 UNITED STATES GRAND PRIX 31 October - 3 November 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 35), have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: 5th Internal Combustion Engine (ICE), 5th Turbocharger (TC), 5th Motor Generator Unit – Heat (MGU-H) and 4th Motor Generator Unit - Kinetic (MGU-K) have been used.
offence: Breach of Article 23.3 a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the race from the rear of the starting grid.
reason: The penalty is imposed in accordance to with Article 23.3 b) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations. This Penalty does not change the fact that the competitor is required to start from the pit lane for a prior infringement (document 31)
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
